actual_output.capture_note: Return values are retained unchanged. captureError for JSON.stringify(undefined) is a recorder serialization limitation, not an application exception. Use observed resulting state for void methods.

expected_output_contract: Motion evolves runtime state only; reset restores initial compiled values. Exact 0.5 s / 1 s states cannot be asserted unless their saved timestamps say so.
expected_diagram: At t=0 pivot and bob should register to their printed locations. Motion should pivot around that fixed point. No exact period can be asserted from the symbolic source alone.
finding: Automatic activation is observed in this checkout. Later frame time is whatever the runtime snapshot records, not an invented exact timestamp.
change_or_loss: The executed main.js path automatically starts after a successful load. Later frames are saved at their actual times. Optics results are static ray solutions rather than pendulum-like time evolution.
